agent_cli_spawn.query: SELECT datetime(e.time,'unixepoch') AS ts, e.pid, e.parent, p.path AS parent_path, e.path, s.team_identifier FROM es_process_events e LEFT JOIN processes p ON p.pid = e.parent LEFT JOIN signature s ON s.path = e.path WHERE e.path LIKE '%/claude%' OR e.path LIKE '%/agent%' OR e.path LIKE '%/codex%' OR e.path LIKE '%/sbx%' ORDER BY e.time DESC LIMIT 50;
agent_cli_spawn.description: Agentic AI CLI and sbx process spawns (Chapter 23)

agent_lotl_chain.query: SELECT datetime(e.time,'unixepoch') AS ts, e.parent, pp.path AS parent_name, e.path AS child FROM es_process_events e JOIN processes pp ON pp.pid = e.parent WHERE (pp.path LIKE '%claude%' OR pp.path LIKE '%agent%' OR pp.path LIKE '%Cursor%') AND e.path IN ('/bin/bash','/bin/zsh','/usr/bin/curl','/usr/bin/python3') ORDER BY e.time DESC LIMIT 30;
agent_lotl_chain.description: LOTL children spawned under agent parents
